data.name: Godefroid
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old French 'Godefroi', meaning 'God's peace' or 'God's protector'. In Christian tradition, the name is associated with Saint Godfrey, a Belgian hermit and patron saint of travelers, students, and monks.

in_hebrew.name: גודפריד
in_hebrew.meaning: פריד נקי, יפה, חזק, אור, שמש
in_hebrew.long_meaning: גודפריד לקוח מהמילה הגרמאנית, פריד, נקי, יפה, חזק, אור, שמש, והמילה גוד, טוב. במסורת נוצרית, גודפריד קשורה לסנט גודפריד, מלך בלגיה, שנחשב למגן הבישוף של קולוניה. השם קשור לרוח הנוצרית ולערכי הנצרות. בתרבות היהודית, גודפריד יכול לסמל חיים, אור, ושמחה.

in_greek.name: Γοδεφρείδος
in_greek.long_meaning: Γοδεφρείδος προέρχεται από τη γερμανική λέξη Φρέιν, που σημαίνει ελεύθερος, εύκολος, ισχυρός, φως, ήλιος. Στη χριστιανική παράδοση, ο Γοδεφρείδος συνδέεται με τον Άγιο Γοδεφρείδο, βασιλιά της Βελγίας, ο οποίος θεωρείται προστάτης επίσκοπος της Κολωνίας. Ο όρος συνδέεται με το χριστιανικό πνεύμα και την αξία της χριστιανικής ηθικής. Στηกรεκκολαυτική τέχνη, Γοδεφρείδος ήταν ο τίτλος των βασιλέων της Βουργουνδίας και της Γαλλίας. Η λέξη συνδέεται επίσης με την ιδέα της απελευθέρωσης και της απελευθερώσεως.

in_latin.name: Godefroidus
in_latin.long_meaning: Godefroidus derivatur a vocabulo Germanico, Frein, quod significat liber, facilitas, fortitudo, lux, sol. In traditione Christiana, Godefroidus connectur cum Sancto Godefrido, rege Belgii, qui habetur patronus episcoporum Coloniensis. Nomen connectur cum spiritu Christiano et valoribus moralibus Christianis. In arte Gothica, Godefroidus erat titulus regum Burgundiae et Franciae. Lex connectur etiam cum idearum liberationis et libertatis.

historical_references.reference: Godefroid de Bouillon, a Belgian nobleman, played a significant role in the First Crusade (1096-1099). He led the army that captured Jerusalem, marking the end of Byzantine rule and the beginning of the Crusader States in the Levant.

Godefroid de Bouillon, one of the prominent Crusade leaders, led the army that captured Jerusalem, which marked the end of Byzantine rule and the beginning of the Crusader States in the Levant. The capture of Jerusalem was a turning point in the Crusades and had a lasting impact on European history.

historical_references.reference: Godefroid de Brabant, also known as Godfrey of Bouillon, was a Count of Namur and a significant figure in the Northern Crusades (12th to 14th centuries). He led a crusade against the pagan Wends in the region of Pomerania, and established the territories of Brandenburg and East Prussia as part of the Holy Roman Empire.
historical_references.context: The Northern Crusades were a series of military campaigns launched by the Catholic Church to expand its influence in the Baltic region and convert the pagan peoples living there to Christianity. Godefroid de Brabant, a Count of Namur, led a crusade against the Wends in the region of Pomerania in the late 12th century. He successfully conquered the territory and established the territories of Brandenburg and East Prussia as part of the Holy Roman Empire. This marked the beginning of German colonization and Christianization in the region, which had a profound impact on the political and cultural development of Eastern Europe.
